notes.title: FESTERED demo is now playable on steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42264064/2bcbb79f1a4550bc813631b3b8a55559c380c64b.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hello people![/b][/h3]

This is just a quick message to say that the demo for my upcoming horror game FESTERED is out right now!
Don't hesitate to play it and post your feedback!
And of course don't hesitate to post a review too!


🔗[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3460970/FESTERED_Demo/]Check it out here[/url]
Or just write "FESTERED Demo" into the Steam search bar. 🔍

-Fazerdoo
